spans.s: SV0171 नैष्टिक हेतु naiṣṭika hetu Nishṭha refers to permanently getting rid from the sufferings/ pain, and Hetu refers to cause. Diseases hinder the person from getting salvation, so diseases are considered as Naișṭhika Hetu.
SV0172 नैष्टिकी चिकित्सा naiṣṭikī cikitsā It’s made up of two words. Nishṭha and Chikitsa. Nishṭha refers to permanently getting rid from the sufferings / pain. Means for this is naiṣṭikī cikitsā
